title: SLONKS
author: Blockhash
facts: candidate-palette classifier — per-pixel 18-way argmax over learned embeddings
reconstruct all 10,000 CryptoPunks at 24×24 from 10-byte embeddings
214,048 int8 bytes in 9 SSTORE2 data contracts; locked onchain forever
203,680 learned int8 values (10,000×10 embeddings + 576×18×10 pixel heads)
argmax of dot(embedding[token], head[pixel, k]); the winner indexes a candidate color table
offchain on the CryptoPunks image set; 95.77% pixel accuracy
576 palette indexes — a 24×24 reconstruction of the source punk
ERC-721 + swappable renderer + merge manager; the model contract is locked
description: Slonks redraws all 10,000 CryptoPunks with a small model that lives on Ethereum. For each pixel, the model scores 18 candidate colors against a learned 10-byte embedding. The best score wins. The weights fill nine data contracts and can never change. The model runs inside Ethereum. The pixels the model gets wrong are the art.

call.note: renderSourcePixels(0) — runs the model inside Ethereum for punk #0 and returns 576 palette indexes, one per pixel

preview.note: Each byte is an index into the 222-color CryptoPunks palette. The preview shows the indexes as gray levels, not the true colors.
